text.blurb: Every style of music, made from only the six sounds that came with your 3.1 system: the chimes, the chord, the ding, the ta-da and the two ring sounds. Easy to use. Free updates for registered users!
intro: Welcome to HERITAGE EDITION 3.x! Every preset on this disc is made from the six sounds that come with your computer: CHIMES, CHORD, DING, TADA, RINGIN and RINGOUT. Nothing else! You do not need any extra sound files.

I taught school band for 31 years, and I always told my students that a good musician can play anything on anything. This disc is my proof. There is house music, techno, organ, bells and even a little video-game music, all from six system sounds.
maker_note: HERITAGE EDITION is SHAREWARE. That means you can try it FREE for 30 days. If you like it and keep using it, you MUST register. Registration is only $15.00.
When you register you get the BONUS disk with extra registrations, a printed manual, and free updates by mail. You also get my thanks, and you help me keep writing programs!
Thank you for trying Heritage Edition. Please write to me with your ideas. I answer every letter.
install: Put the disc in your CD-ROM drive. In the Library tab of the synthesizer, the disc shows up as HERITAGE21.
Double-click any preset (*.BSP) in one of the directories to load it.
That is all! There is nothing to install on your hard disk.
history: More presets. Fixed the tuning of the TADA bass.
Now on CD-ROM as well as 3.5" disk. Added the help file.
First release, a Christmas present to all of you.
